name: Nobrainer - BrainParcellation
summary: Segments a T1-weighted image into a FreeSurfer-style whole-brain parcellation with the kwyk Bayesian neural network (nobrainer), with entropy and variance maps of prediction uncertainty.
description: Runs the neuronets/kwyk 0.4 GPU container on the T1w image with the chosen model and number of Monte Carlo samples, producing mean-label parcellations in the original and the conformed (FreeSurfer) space plus entropy and, except for the bwn model, variance maps. Needs a GPU node. Note that the code writes the original-space prediction to parc and the conformed-space prediction to parc_fs, which is the opposite of the registry descriptions (see report).

outputs.description: contains entrypy and variance (optional) for prediction uncertainty.
contains entrypy and variance (optional) for prediction uncertainty.

parameters.description: Number of samples you wish to run (ignored for bwn/MAP)
kwyk model passed to -m: bvwn_multi_prior, bwn_multi or bwn (bwn is the MAP model without variance output).
